biography:
At Google, I apply my nine years of electric utility experience and my dual master's degrees in energy and earth resources and global policy studies to lead and support the development long-term, carbon free energy solutions that promote a sustainable and reliable grid.

My core competencies include energy and environmental market analysis and modeling, renewable energy and storage procurement and contract management, power purchase agreement negotiations, asset purchases, integrated resource plans, risk management, and compliance reporting. I have extensive knowledge and experience in various regional and international markets, such as ERCOT, MISO, PJM, CAISO, NYISO, ISO-NE, SPP, and others. I am a high achiever, a marathon runner, and a local running group leader, and I value collaboration, innovation, and excellence in my work.
